verdict.rationale: The SDK reference documents MCP server configuration in Mastra Code: programmatic configs that merge with file-based configs. This is the product's own MCP-client capability, but it is a single reference line with no detail on how the agent exposes or uses those servers' tools. Missing for 10: a dedicated MCP setup guide (config file format, supported transports), explicit documentation that MCP tools become available to the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Programmatic MCP server configs, merged with file-based configs
